## Featured Projects
1. **DriveHub Dealership** (https://srs-dealership.vercel.app/):
   - Strict Test-Driven Development (TDD) full-stack car dealership inventory platform.
   - FastAPI backend with Neon PostgreSQL, Pytest suite with 93% code coverage, React frontend.
   - GitHub: https://github.com/em-srs/srs-dealership

2. **Used Car Price Predictor** (https://car-price-predictor-hkae.onrender.com/):
   - End-to-end continuous regression ML system estimating used car valuations in INR (₹) across 8 parameters.
   - Leakage-free Scikit-Learn preprocessing pipeline (median/mode imputation, One-Hot Encoding).
   - Linear Regression selected over Random Forest (Test MAE: ₹84,198 vs ₹91,965, R²: 0.8079).
   - Served with FastAPI, Pydantic gateway schema validation, 12 Pytest tests, automated Git CI/CD on Render.
   - GitHub: https://github.com/em-srs/car_price_predictor

3. **Custombix** (https://custombix.vercel.app/):
   - Timed aptitude exam generator built on IndiaBIX question banks.
   - Node.js & Express scraping pipeline using Cheerio, SQLite in WAL mode, worker thread PDF generation, and circuit breaker patterns.

4. **MediFly** (https://medi-fly.vercel.app/):
   - 5-role pharmacy delivery ecosystem (User, Pharmacy, Pharmacist, Rider, Admin).
   - React frontend, Node.js/Express backend, PostgreSQL (Supabase), Clerk authentication, Razorpay payments, Socket.io tracking.

5. **Through the Lens** (https://srs-shots.vercel.app/):
   - Portrait, landscape, and astrophotography portfolio showcasing visual composition.
   - GitHub: https://github.com/em-srs/srs-shots-portfolio
